preconditions: The system I2C bus must already be configured.
Any battery or external supply path should already be present before initialization.
steps: Probe the PMU on the configured I2C address.
Read the power-source and battery-status registers.
Apply project-local charge, regulator, and wake-source policy.

checks: Read at least one power-status register.
If exposed, sample the PMU interrupt line.
smokeTest.passCriteria: The PMU responds on I2C and returns coherent power-status data.
failureNotes: A present board can still boot with reduced power-control visibility if the PMU probe fails.
Battery absence should not be treated as a PMU communication failure.

highLevel.name: pmu_read_status
highLevel.description: Read current power-path, battery, and charger status.

highLevel.name: pmu_configure_wakeup
highLevel.description: Enable or disable wake sources exposed by the PMU.
